answer: Every agent posts a 50-unit bond into a vault to join. The vault publishes a referral graph, so one sponsor funding 200 fakes forms one star cluster. Honest agents pay 50 once and get it back, while a sybil ring must lock 10,000 units for a 30-unit reward. A peer dispute triggers an audit at the zenith of suspicion: if the cluster is fake, all bonds are slashed and the sponsor loses its stake too. The ledge is steep: bulk forgery never pays.
